gloss: to throw in; to invest; to cast (a vote)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {投|とう}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to throw in; to cast into
definitions.explanation: To throw or drop something into a place, such as casting a stone into water or throwing oneself into something.

definitions.gloss: to invest; to put in (resources, effort)
definitions.explanation: To commit money, resources, or effort toward a purpose.
To submit a vote in an election or poll.

examples.english: I threw a stone into the pond.
He plunged into the sea as if throwing himself in.

notes:
An ichidan verb (じる form of {投|とう}ずる) meaning to throw into, invest, or cast. A somewhat formal and literary verb that covers physical throwing, financial/resource investment, and voting.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to throw oneself into (an activity, a cause); to devote oneself
- {一票|いっぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to cast a vote
- {一石|いっせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to make waves; to raise an issue (lit. "throw a stone")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to invest funds
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to invest a budget
- ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to cast a vote
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|とう}じる — to throw oneself into

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to invest (financially); specifically about financial investment, while {投|とう}じる is broader
- ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ — to throw; the everyday word for physical throwing, while {投|とう}じる is more literary
